protocol.train_only_rule: all generator and RF fitting rows satisfy log10 conductivity <= nominal Q80
protocol.locked_holdout_rule: rows above nominal Q80 are excluded from fitting, tuning, filtering and selection until post-run audit
protocol.strict_hit_definition: valid, exact-training-novel, nearest-train Tanimoto >= 0.35, RF tree SD < 0.35, abs RF target error < 0.5
protocol.upper_tail_hit_definition: valid, exact-training-novel, support/uncertainty gated, RF prediction > actual training maximum

alternative_binary_sensitivity.definition: training-median binary cutoff, balanced only within the truncated training distribution
alternative_binary_sensitivity.status: not_executed; would be a different binary estimand and is retained as the prespecified fallback
